Name: Barreleye not S Fish
Author: briarbrews
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod changes the name of the Night Market 'S***k Fish' to its actual name of 'Barreleye'. [/color][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Just wanted to make my game a little more culturally sensitive and figured I would let others do the same. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Unzip the file and place it in your mods folder. 
Make sure you also have content patcher installed or this mod won't work. 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Changes the name of the 'S***k Fish' to 'Barreleye'.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher is required for this mod to work![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch]BogWyytch[/url] for encouraging me to make mods and for helping me troubleshoot while I was creating this mod. [/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Bog is one of my favorite mod authors ever and a wonderful friend, you should all check out her mods because they are the best!![/color][/size]
